thread:
alejandro: Drafting the internal release note + microcopy for tomorrow's change window. Need quick signoffs on the short 'What changed' lines, the pinned version decisions for Dedicated, and rollback criteria. Draft here: https://tiny.redwood/release-draft-17388

tina: on it. can you share the 1-2 line bullets for internal blurb?

alejandro: sure — copying the short lines below. feel free to edit.
```
- Serving runtime: median token latency down ~12% across typical prompts
- Batching: FIFO + queue smoothing to reduce tail stalls
- Model: v2.3.1 (int8-quant) -> pinned for Dedicated; hosted will auto-fallback to v2.3.0 if needed
- Config: default max_batch_size set to 256 to avoid queuing spikes
```

priya: small suggestion: spell out `int8-quant` (so support/CS know what to expect). also add a Known Issues line: "rare timeouts for >32k context workloads" so customers see the note.

mike: rollback triggers we agreed on in the runbook: error rate > 1.5% sustained for 10m OR p95 token latency +40% vs baseline for 10m. If either happens, pause rollout and roll back to `v2.3.0`.

ops-oncall: change window confirmed: 2025-06-05 02:00-04:00 UTC, hard stop at 02:45 UTC. oncall during deploy: @mike primary, @ops-oncall standby. post any handoffs in #eng-oncall.

tina: microcopy for internal announce (short): "Planned rollout: performance & rollout fixes. No action required. Monitoring active — contact support if you see errors or latency regressions." Thoughts?

alejandro: that's concise. I'll post that to #eng, #support, and #customer-success after approvals. Who will pin the RN to the release board and update the changelog once canary passes? @mike?

mike: I'll handle the release board pin and changelog update. I'll also trigger the canary once approvals are in. scheduling in ~15m.

deploy-bot: Deploy queued by mike — canary start at 1738800600. Plan: 5% -> 25% -> 100% with health checks at each step. Auto-rollback enabled with thresholds: error_rate>1.5% or p95_latency>+40%.

priya: ack. adding the internal eval run link to the RN draft: https://tiny.redwood/evals/17388 (contains canary metrics to monitor).

alejandro: thanks everyone. I'll paste final internal snippet and the support-facing microcopy in 5m. @tina please give the :thumbsup: on the microcopy before I hit send. :pray:

tina: :thumbsup: looks good to me. go ahead.

mike: starting canary now. will report back at each gate.

deploy-bot: Canary started at 1738800605 — 5% traffic. Monitoring: latency, error_rate, tail-percentiles.

alejandro: marking this thread done — will follow up in pinned release board and post the internal announce once canary passes the first gate.
